species.tagline: An insect that digs tunnels underground

tasks.title: Look at the front legs
tasks.message: Its front legs are shaped like shovels, built for digging.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a mole cricket. Its front legs are shovels for digging soil.

tasks.title: Where it lives
tasks.message: It spends most of its life in tunnels underground.
tasks.subtitle: Mole crickets live in tunnels under the soil. They come out at night, so few people see them.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.hint: Remember: soil is a home too
tasks.message: Healthy soil is where the underground creatures live.
tasks.subtitle: There is life under the ground too. Clean soil gives it somewhere to live. Thank you!
